name: Semi-transparent Empty-Space Skipping
aliases: Semi-transparent Volumetric Rendering with Empty-Space Skipping
definition: A rendering approach for transparent or semi-transparent objects with constant density material where the ray continues inside toward the exit point, and the optical contribution of the inner ray segment is evaluated analytically from its length.
summary: Semi-transparent Empty-Space Skipping is a rendering technique that uses BVH lower bounds and analytical integration to efficiently skip inactive regions in semi-transparent volumes.
